concerns.text: T005d (Generate state YAML) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly lists 'Dependency: T005c (Git Init)'. T005c must complete before T005d can safely write to the .git directory or hash files within it. This violates the [P] tag and the 'Producer before consumer' rule for the git repository state.

T012 (Contract test for data schema) is marked [P] but lists 'Dependency: Requires T009a/b completion'. While T009a/b are in the same phase, T012 consumes the artifacts produced by T009a/b. If T009a/b are not guaranteed to finish before T012 starts (due to parallel execution), T012 will fail. The [P] tag is unsafe here; T012 must be sequential to T009a/b.

T022b (Learning_Phase feature generation) is marked [P] but T027 (LME fitting) depends on it. T022b produces the 'learning_phase' column required by T027. If T027 starts before T022b finishes (parallel execution), the model will fail or use missing data. T022b must precede T027, and the [P] tag on T022b is misleading if it implies independence from the modeling phase start.

T024 (Finalize Aligned Dataset) is marked [P] but explicitly consumes outputs from T016, T023, and T022b. T024 cannot run in parallel with T016, T023, or T022b. The [P] tag is incorrect; T024 is a strict consumer of these tasks and must be ordered after them.

T037 (Strict Real-Data Loader) is marked [P] but introduces a hard failure mode (FileNotFoundError) that contradicts the pipeline's graceful degradation logic in T004 (Log warning and skip). While not a strict ordering violation, the semantic flow suggests T037 should be a configuration or logic update to T001/T014 rather than a standalone parallel task, to ensure the 'skip' logic is consistent before the 'fail' logic is applied.
